title: Geocache screw: the Thread dragged before the Chamfer in the timeline

expect.note: the book's Geocache trick: the thread runs the whole shaft and the chamfer cuts through it. OpenCASCADE cannot chamfer the end of a threaded shaft; Fission 180 builds the bevel on the shaft under the thread and cuts the grooves again (fillet_robust.py). No hand formula for grooves cut by a cone: the number is what FreeCAD 1.1.4 gives, and the two models that reach it by different routes (the thread made first; the thread dragged before the chamfer) must agree. It is less than book_thread_stops_at_chamfer (29567.909): the grooves go on under the bevel
